partners.name: A.R.C Laser
partners.description: Over 35 years specializing in CO2, diode and KTP lasers for surgery, ENT, endoscopy and dermatology. Founded in 1978; A.R.C. Laser GmbH established in 1996. CE Medical certified.

partners.name: CLASSYS
partners.description: Founded in 2007, focused on innovative beauty medical technologies with a global customer base.

partners.name: Cocoon Medical
partners.description: Established in Barcelona in 2010. Pioneer in body contouring, hair removal and skin rejuvenation, exporting to more than 60 countries. CE Medical certified.

partners.name: Erchonia
partners.description: More than 20 years of experience. Founded in 1996, making low-level laser devices for body contouring. FDA approved.

partners.name: Eunsung
partners.description: Founded in 1995, making beauty, slimming and fitness medical equipment. CE Medical, ISO 9001 and ISO 13485 certified.

partners.name: IDS
partners.description: More than 30 years as a top manufacturer of CO2 fractional lasers and RF rejuvenation systems, distributed to over 45 countries. Meets CE Medical and FDA standards.

partners.name: InBody
partners.description: More than 25 years in body composition analysis, and the first company to develop such devices, in 1996. FDA approved and ISO 81060-2:2018 certified.

partners.name: Iskra Medical
partners.description: Magnetic field and muscle stimulation technologies for slimming and physiotherapy. ISO 9001, ISO 13485 and CE Medical certified.

partners.name: Loktal
partners.description: Headquartered in Sophia Antipolis and ISO 13485 certified. Its Exciplex device is recognised in more than 40 countries.

partners.name: Sinclair
partners.description: Founded in 1971, a global medical aesthetics company selling in 55 countries. Acquired by Huadong Medicine Ltd in 2018.

partners.name: Clarteis
partners.description: Based in Sophia Antipolis, making advanced RF technology for surgery, cosmetics, dentistry and veterinary use. CE Medical certified.

partners.name: Novaclinical
partners.description: Italian manufacturer of dynamic quadrupole radiofrequency systems for body contouring and skin rejuvenation.
